from hamana.connector.db.query import Query
from hamana.core.column import IntegerColumn, StringColumn, DateColumn

# Define the SQL query
sql_query = "SELECT id, name, created_at FROM users"

# Define the column schema with explicit typed columns
columns = [
    IntegerColumn(name="id", order=0),
    StringColumn(name="name", order=1),
    DateColumn(name="created_at", order=2),
]

# Create the Query with the SQL and column schema
query = Query(query=sql_query, columns=columns)

# Display the query and its columns
print(f"Query: {query.query}")
print(f"Columns: {[f'{col.name} ({col.dtype.value})' for col in query.columns]}")
